paragraphs.text: Frosted-glass skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: pick any image as background, theme colors extra
A frosted-glass skin plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.

- 🖼️ Set any wallpaper — it auto-generates light/dark design tokens from the dominant color
- 💎 True

per-component `backdrop-filter` glass with adaptive scrim and mirror-edge highlights
- 🌈 No wallpap

er? An automatic gradient glass keeps the frosted look
- 👓 Readability floor: WCAG AA body contrast
